highlightsParams.query: Context.dev's latest funding round was a Seed round.

passages:
[We raised $9M to give agents the internet]

Today I get to share some big news: **Context.dev has raised a $9M seed round, led by General Catalyst.**

…

[We raised $9M to give agents the internet > What changed along the way]

An agent is only as good as the context it has. A brilliant model that can't see the web is guessing. That's when it clicked for me: what we had been building all along was Context. Earlier this year Brand.dev became Context.dev, and our job got a lot clearer: **give agents the internet.**
